_about: Sprint 18 wave 2 (s18-g-chaat; the sprint's 'Coded well' rule 1: a game is its settings file plus its own mechanic): chaat's own numbers, read by js/cook/mechanics/assemble.js (the bowl) before it builds; everything else is a kit call. bowl: the side-on glass bowl in the scene (design px of the 1600x900 box: w its drawn width, x its centre; res the layers' canvas over the bowl's design size), its layers (band: a layer's flat texture, w bowl px and pad above and below; thin: a layer's thickness as a share of a full one; drizzle: the chutneys, drizzled over the layer below; bandScale: a layer's pieces as a share of their size in the pot; potFood: the food inside a pot, the layers' texture, as fractions of the pot). The bowl's measured inside and the pots' one canvas stay in the code (BOWL, BOWL_INSIDE, POT: build/check_vessel_meta.py reads them there). shelf: the line the pots stand on (base), the slot each wants (pitch) and a pot's width (potW), the span the row is centred on (the whole band, centred under the bowl: the tick is gone, SH-238; s19-wave-d: at 930x430 the old span left of the tick made the chutney's pill touch its neighbour's, contract-92), the word pills' line (chipY); the pills themselves are the shared kit's (js/shared/shelf.js). pots, strips: each topping's pot and its side-on strip (the s08b strips stand in for CHT-13's side-on layers, CHT-04). motion: the spoonful (w design px), its flight back (backMs), its drop (dropMs), the layer rising as it goes in (fillMs, CK-83: chai's pan fills over about a second), a wrong thing's pause before the wobble and its way out (notInPauseMs, outMs), a double tap (doubleTapMs), the right bowl's moment (rightHoldMs), the right way shown (showGlowMs, showHoldMs), the recast's cap (recastCapMs), the end (endMs). levels: what changes by level over data.mechanics.assemble (flyMs: a spoonful's flight to the bowl, about 15% quicker a level, STD-C2-06). The decoys and the counts are the central rules' (data/rules.json), never here (STD-F2-02).

pots._tomato: pot-tomato is a stand-in (build/make_chaat_tomato_pot.py): no tomato on the T2 sheet; pot-potato-v2: ART-11's matte cream flesh

tops._about: S19 (s19-wave-e2): each topping's own top, drawn straight down (the full run's C5-C11, cut by build/tools/art/s19_cut.py), seen as the top layer's surface through the bowl's mouth (assemble.js topSurface). The chutneys are the drizzles (Zafar, 10 Nov: C5-drizzle #111, C10-drizzle #110); the ribbons and smears stay cut beside them (layer-lili, layer-amli). Potato, chickpeas and sev have none yet (the mini run's C2-C4 are not cut): their strip's own top stays their surface.
